usedFor: Mailparser turns incoming email into structured data, and Razorpay receives it as a payment link or invoice through “Create Invoice”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: Parsed email fields can fill the amount and customer details of a shareable payment link.

watchOut: “New Parsed Email (one request per row)” sends one request per row, so a table can run the action repeatedly.
